Project.name: frontend-livecoding-tasks
Project.annotation: ARMY-97 replaces the legacy card library with immutable task-ID interview practice.

UC-ARMY97-PRACTICE.Action: Open a thematic task or a static interview simulation.
UC-ARMY97-PRACTICE.AcceptanceCriteria: Every card is self-contained and every simulation is a plausible mixed frontend interview.

UC-ARMY97-PUBLISH.Action: Turn an accepted candidate into a card.
UC-ARMY97-PUBLISH.AcceptanceCriteria: Only accepted candidates receive an immutable task-XXXX path and one thematic projection.

Constraints.constraint-immutable-id: Every published task is tasks/task-XXXX/README.md; its ID is hidden, immutable, never reused, and never renumbered.
Constraints.constraint-card-contract: Card order is title, exact sandbox line, Условие, starter comments containing every requirement, three closed hints, closed solution, and closed five-field metadata.
Constraints.constraint-provenance: No student-facing card, collection, root page, or simulation contains authorship, source provenance, import, or migration language.
Constraints.constraint-catalog: Each task has exactly one thematic collection; React real-work additionally has exactly one real-work projection.
Constraints.constraint-simulations: Exactly thirty static mixed simulations satisfy 30-120 minutes, two thematic collections, three-simulation recurrence, and recorded realism evidence.
Constraints.constraint-validation: Candidate decision, CardMigrationEvidence, full-catalog local validation, XML, Grace, and diff checks gate publication.

NonGoals.item-1: No browser, target-editor, GitHub-rendering, or CSS-layout gate.
